headline: The docs-site container image publishes to GHCR again.
summary: No release from `v2.2.0` through `v2.2.4` published `ghcr.io/blamejs/stash-wiki`, because the release-container workflow failed before the build. This release publishes the image again, on the Node 26.12.1 base `v2.2.4` pinned. The library code is identical to `v2.2.4`, so an npm install does not need to move to `v2.2.5`. If you deploy the docs site with `examples/wiki/docker-compose.prod.yml`, it now pulls `stash-wiki:2.2.5`.

Fixed: The release-container workflow installs git before it checks out the repository. The suite job runs in `node:24.22.1-alpine`, which has no git, so the checkout had no `.git` directory and the pack gate's `git ls-files` failed. The build, scan and publish jobs never ran.
